items.title: Biodiversity credits hold promise, yet credit-generating protocols require safeguards to realize potential
items.title_en: Biodiversity credits hold promise, yet credit-generating protocols require safeguards to realize potential
items.title_zh: 生物多样性信用机制前景广阔，但要充分发挥其潜力，信用生成方案仍需建立相应的保障措施
items.summary_en: Given the existing gap in biodiversity funding, mobilizing private finance will be essential to achieving global biodiversity conservation goals, especially across lower- and middle-income countries with limited capacity and public finance. The emerging voluntary biodiversity market (VBM) holds promise to leverage private finance for biodiversity, but credit-generating protocols must be robust to prevent greenwashing and maximize effectiveness. In this study, the first to move beyond theoretical critiques and general market assessments of the VBM, we extracted details of program structure and crediting issuance from protocols for 13 relatively well-established biodiversity-crediting organizations. With these data, we evaluated protocols’ alignment with both conservation and restoration biology principles and lessons learned from the voluntary carbon market (VCM). We find that action must be taken to improve quantification of biodiversity impacts, especially incorporating patch size and connectivity in crediting and assessing projects on ecologically relevant timelines. Further, safeguards for additionality, leakage, risk, and verification from the VCM must be more robustly integrated in the VBM, and deep engagement and investment in local communities must be improved to ensure durable biodiversity-positive outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 鉴于当前生物多样性资金缺口，调动私人资本对于实现全球生物多样性保护目标至关重要，特别是在能力有限且公共财政紧张的中低收入国家。新兴的自愿性生物多样性市场（VBM）有望为生物多样性保护撬动私人资本，但信用生成协议必须足够健全，以防止“洗绿”行为并最大限度地提高成效。 本研究是首项超越对自愿生物多样性市场（VBM）的理论批判和一般性市场评估的研究，我们从13家相对成熟的生物多样性信用组织的工作规程中，提取了项目结构和信用额度发放的详细信息。 基于这些数据，我们评估了这些协议与保护和恢复生物学原则以及自愿碳市场（VCM）经验教训的一致性。我们发现，必须采取行动改进生物多样性影响的量化工作，特别是将斑块大小和连通性纳入信用核算，并在生态相关的时限内评估项目。 此外，必须将自愿碳市场（VCM）中关于额外性、泄漏、风险和核查的保障措施更牢固地融入生物多样性碳信用市场（VBM），并加强与当地社区的深度互动及投资，以确保实现持久的、对生物多样性有利的成果。

items.title: Effects of high elevation wildfires on peak snow water equivalent in California’s Sierra Nevada headwater regions
items.title_en: Effects of high elevation wildfires on peak snow water equivalent in California’s Sierra Nevada headwater regions
items.title_zh: 高海拔森林火灾对加利福尼亚州内华达山脉源头地区峰值积雪水当量的影响
items.summary_en: Increases in high‐elevation wildfires in California’s Sierra Nevada region (SNR) have raised concerns about potential impacts on snowpack, a major source for the state’s water supply. Quantifying fire-induced changes in snow storage remains challenging in mountainous regions with complex topography and large climatic and ecological gradients, due to limited field observations and process models. This study leveraged high-resolution airborne snow observatory lidar surveys (2023–2024) to assess the impacts of 2020–2021 wildfires on peak snow water equivalent (SWE) across six SNR watersheds. We assembled >32000 matched burned-unburned 50 m pixel pairs with similar pre-fire environmental conditions and assessed how changes in peak SWE (ΔpeakSWE: burned—unburned) varied with burn severity, pre-fire forest structure, meteorological variables, and terrain above the snowline. Across matched pairs, post-fire peak SWE differences varied in both magnitude and direction, depending on yearly weather (e.g. wet vs. normal year) and local environmental setting. The largest positive burned–unburned difference occurred in dense forests with ⩾75% canopy loss at intermediate elevations in 2023, where burned areas had 13.0 cm higher peak SWE on average (12% relative to the matched unburned mean of 105.1 cm); this difference was substantially smaller in 2024. The spatially cross-validated extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) machine learning model showed terrain provided the strongest predictive information, followed by vegetation structure. SHapley Additive exPlanations and a shallow decision tree further showed that sites with lower heat exposure, locally lower terrain positions, and intermediate elevations generally were associated with higher peak SWE in burned areas compared to matched unburned areas, whereas taller pre-fire canopies and exposed, high-energy terrain were associated with lower peak SWE. These results demonstrate wildfire effects on peak SWE are strongly context dependent and provide an assessment framework for anticipating where high elevation wildfires may increase or reduce mountain snow storage.
items.summary_zh: 加利福尼亚州内华达山脉地区（SNR）高海拔野火的增多，引发了人们对积雪可能受到影响的担忧——积雪是该州供水的主要来源。 在地形复杂、气候和生态梯度较大的山区，由于实地观测和过程模型的局限性，量化火灾引起的积雪储量变化仍具挑战性。 本研究利用高分辨率机载雪观测站激光雷达测绘数据（2023–2024年），评估了2020–2021年野火对内华达山脉地区六个流域峰值积雪水当量（SWE）的影响。 我们汇集了超过32000组环境条件相似的“烧毁区-未烧毁区”50米像素配对数据，并评估了峰值雪水当量变化（ΔpeakSWE：烧毁区—未烧毁区）如何随火灾严重程度、火灾前森林结构、气象变量以及雪线以上地形的变化而变化。 在配对数据中，火灾后峰值SWE的差异在幅度和方向上均存在变化，这取决于年度天气状况（例如多雨年与常年）以及当地的环境条件。 2023年，在中等海拔地区，冠层损失率≥75%的密林中出现了最大的正向“烧过区—未烧过区”差异，该区域烧过区的峰值雪水当量平均高出13.0厘米（相对于匹配未烧过区平均值105.1厘米高出12%）； 而在2024年，这一差异则显著缩小。经过空间交叉验证的极端梯度提升（XGBoost）机器学习模型表明，地形提供了最强的预测信息，其次是植被结构。 夏普利加性解释（SHapley Additive exPlanations）和浅层决策树进一步表明，与匹配的未烧毁区域相比，热暴露较低、局部地形位置较低且海拔处于中等的地点，其烧毁区域的峰值雪水当量通常较高；而火灾前树冠较高以及暴露、高能的地形则与较低的峰值雪水当量相关。 这些结果表明，野火对峰值土壤水当量（SWE）的影响在很大程度上取决于具体情境。

items.title: Increasing favorability for intense tropical cyclone activity in the northern South China Sea
items.title_en: Increasing favorability for intense tropical cyclone activity in the northern South China Sea
items.title_zh: 南海北部出现强热带气旋活动的可能性正在增加
items.summary_en: The South China Sea (SCS) is one of the most active marginal seas for tropical cyclones (TCs) worldwide and a key region for TC hazards along the coasts of southern China, Philippines and Vietnam. However, the drivers of long-term changes in intense TC development in this region remain unclear. Here, we show that the number of TCs reaching Category 3–5 intensity has increased significantly, with more occurring in the northern SCS. This change is primarily linked to an increasing contribution of western North Pacific TCs entering through the Luzon Strait, which experience weaker land-induced weakening than those crossing the Philippine archipelago and retain greater intensity for subsequent development. After entering the SCS, reduced ocean cooling and enhanced oceanic and atmospheric conditions have increased the environmental favorability for intense TC development in the northern SCS. These results highlight the role of regional ocean-land-atmosphere interactions in reshaping where TCs reach high intensities.
items.summary_zh: 南海是全球热带气旋活动最为频繁的边缘海之一，也是中国南部、菲律宾和越南沿海地区热带气旋灾害的关键区域。然而，该地区强热带气旋形成与发展的长期变化驱动因素尚不明确。 本文表明，达到3至5级强度的热带气旋数量显著增加，且其中更多出现在南海北部。 这一变化主要与通过吕宋海峡进入南海的西北太平洋热带气旋所占比例日益增大有关，与穿越菲律宾群岛的热带气旋相比，这些气旋受陆地影响导致的强度减弱较弱，从而能够保持更强的强度以供后续发展。 进入南海后，海洋冷却作用减弱以及海洋和大气条件增强，使得南海北部更有利于强台风的发展。这些结果凸显了区域海洋-陆地-大气相互作用在重塑台风达到高强度区域方面的作用。

items.title: Interdecadal Pacific variability modulates recent drying and near-term changes in early-spring precipitation over subtropical East Asia
items.title_en: Interdecadal Pacific variability modulates recent drying and near-term changes in early-spring precipitation over subtropical East Asia
items.title_zh: 太平洋的十年际变率对亚热带东亚近期干旱以及早春降水的近期变化具有调节作用
items.summary_en: Subtropical East Asia (SEA), among the world’s most densely populated regions and a major agricultural region, has experienced pronounced early-spring drying since the 1980s, posing growing risks to water resources and agriculture. However, the relative contributions of external forcing and internal variability to the drying trend, as well as the associated dynamic and thermodynamic processes, remain unclear. The circulation analogues-based dynamic adjustment reveals that atmospheric circulation changes explain approximately 108% of the observed drying trend, which were largely driven by internal variability. These circulation changes are closely linked to a positive-to-negative phase transition of the interdecadal Pacific variability (IPV), which can suppress precipitation by weakening the Northwest Pacific anticyclone and inducing anomalous subsidence over SEA. The IPV also modulates near-term precipitation projections. Based on the projected IPV inferred from ensemble members that realistically capture the historical IPV, we identify a likely reversal toward wetter conditions in the near future.
items.summary_zh: 亚热带东亚（SEA）作为全球人口最稠密的地区之一及重要的农业区，自20世纪80年代以来一直面临着显著的早春干旱现象，这对水资源和农业构成了日益加剧的风险。 然而，外部强迫和内部变率对干旱化趋势的相对贡献，以及相关的动力学和热力学过程，目前尚不明确。基于环流类比的动力学分析表明，大气环流变化可解释观测到的干旱化趋势的约108%，而这些变化主要由内部变率驱动。 这些环流变化与太平洋十年际变率（IPV）从正相位向负相位的转变密切相关，这种转变会通过削弱西北太平洋反气旋并在东南亚（SEA）引发异常下沉气流来抑制降水。 IPV 还调节着短期降水预测。基于能够真实反映历史 IPV 的集合成员推导出的 IPV 预测，我们发现近期未来可能出现向更湿润条件逆转的趋势。

items.title: Spatially distributed air quality and health impacts of data center electricity demand in the United States
items.title_en: Spatially distributed air quality and health impacts of data center electricity demand in the United States
items.title_zh: 美国数据中心电力需求对空气质量及健康影响的空间分布
items.summary_en: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence is driving substantial growth in electricity demand from data centers in the US, yet how the resulting air quality and public health impacts are distributed remain poorly quantified. To trace the ambient air pollution and associated premature mortality impacts of grid-supplied data center electricity demand in 2023, we couple the United States Electricity Generation Optimization model with the GEOS-Chem chemical transport model. We compare hourly, unit-level electricity dispatch with and without data center demand to quantify changes in power-sector emissions, ambient PM and ozone, and associated premature mortality. Our results show that electricity generation attributable to data center demand is largely supplied by fossil fuel units across multiple regions, resulting in additional annual mean PM concentrations of 0.02–0.08 g m (local peak concentrations up to 0.2 g m ), and regionally varying ozone responses characterized by wintertime depletion and summertime enhancement. These impacts are most pronounced in the Midwest United States, where marginal emissions from coal-fired units and ammonia-rich atmospheric conditions enhance secondary particulate formation. We estimate that this grid-supplied demand is responsible for 513 (95% CI: 469–557) annual premature mortalities from PM and an additional 137 (95% CI: 90–183) annually from maximum daily 8 h average ozone (MDA8- ) in the contiguous US. State-level analysis reveals a systematic geographic mismatch: states hosting the largest data center loads do not necessarily experience the highest attributable mortality rates, while some states with little data center demand bear substantial burdens. This mismatch arises because of dispatch across interconnected electricity regions, regional differences in generation and emissions, and atmospheric chemistry and transport, which together separate the locations of demand from those of exposure and mortality. These findings highlight the importance of considering both air quality impacts and their spatial distribution in data center and macro-energy system planning.

items.summary_en: The following is a summary of global temperature conditions in Berkeley Earth’s analysis of October 2026. October 2026 was the warmest October on record, with a global average of 1.80 ± 0.12 °C (3.25 ± 0.22 °F) above the 1850–1900 average, about 0.12 °C above the previous record set in October 2023. By anomaly, it was also nominally the warmest month of any kind since 1850. Land temperatures averaged 2.35 ± 0.14 °C (4.24 ± 0.25 °F) above the 1850–1900 average, nominally the 3rd warmest October for terrestrial regions. Ocean temperatures were 1.34 ± 0.10 °C (2.42 ± 0.18 °F) above the 1850–1900 average, the warmest October on record for ocean surfaces by a clear margin. El Niño continued to strengthen through October and is at record strength. Forecasts now place its peak around December 2026, beyond any event in the modern record. Roughly 14.4% of Earth’s surface experienced its warmest October on record. Record October heat hit mainland Southeast Asia. Vietnam beat its national October record by 0.94 °C in our analysis, with national records also in Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, the Philippines and Thailand. 2026 is now almost certain (~97%) to become the warmest year in Berkeley Earth’s record, up from ~96% in the September update. It is virtually certain to exceed 1.5 °C (2.7 °F) above the 1850–1900 average. Global Summary According to Berkeley Earth’s high-resolution temperature dataset, October 2026 was the warmest October since records began in 1850, with a monthly global average of 1.80 ± 0.12 °C (3.25 ± 0.22 °F) above the 1850–1900 (pre-industrial) average. It finished about 0.12 °C above October 2023, the previous record holder, and the rank is unambiguous once the uncertainties are taken into account. Measured as an anomaly, October 2026 was also nominally the warmest month of any kind among the 2122 months since 1850. Global average temperature for the month of October in each year since 1850, relative to the 1850–1900 average. October 2026 sits at the top of the record, about 0.12 °C above October 2023. October was a slight increase from September and continued the climb that began in mid-year. Global temperatures have moved well above the long-term trend line as the strengthening El Niño adds its warming influence to the global average. Monthly global mean temperature since 1980, relative to the 1850–1900 average, with the long-term trend in red. October 2026 is the highest point on the chart, though within the uncertainty of several earlier months. Global temperature anomaly by calendar month for every year since 1850. The 2026 trace (black) has moved above all prior years for October. The 12-month moving average has turned sharply upward. After falling back toward the long-term trend through 2025 and early 2026, it has risen above the trend line again and is approaching the peak reached in 2024. This short-term variability is an inherent part of the climate system and is expected even alongside persistent long-term global warming. 12-month moving average of global mean temperature with its 95% uncertainty range, plus a 30-year LOWESS smooth (red) indicating the long-term trend. Anomalies are relative to the 1850–1900 average. Spatial Variation In October 2026, warmer-than-average temperatures covered nearly the entire globe. Warmth was especially pronounced across the central and eastern equatorial Pacific, where the El Niño warm tongue dominates the map, and over the Arabian Peninsula, Iran and the Persian Gulf, northern Russia and the Barents Sea, Scandinavia, northern Canada, eastern China and Japan, and the Antarctic Peninsula. The most notable cool anomaly covered Argentina and Paraguay, which were unusually cool for October against their own history. October 2026 surface temperature anomalies relative to the 1951–1980 average. The warm tongue along the equatorial Pacific reflects the strong El Niño. Gray areas, in parts of east-central Africa and coastal Antarctica, indicate regions with insufficient data this month. Roughly 14.4% of Earth’s surface experienced its locally warmest October on record (about 10.4% of land and 16.4% of ocean surfaces). Record warmth covered a large part of the tropical Pacific, the tropical and subtropical North Atlantic, the Arabian Peninsula and Persian Gulf, the Arabian Sea and much of the tropical Indian Ocean, mainland Southeast Asia and the South China Sea, equatorial Africa, northern South America, much of the South Atlantic. The eastern tropical Pacific warmth is due to the current El Niño event. Broad warmth continuing to extend across much of the tropics is also a common feature during Super El Niño events. Near-record cold for October was confined to a small part of East Antarctica, South America, and a few scattered patches of ocean. How October 2026 ranked locally against all Octobers since 1850. items.summary_zh: 以下是伯克利地球（Berkeley Earth）对2026年10月全球气温状况分析的摘要。2026年10月是有记录以来最暖的10月，全球平均气温比1850–1900年的平均值高出1.80 ± 0.12 °C （3.25 ± 0.22 °F），比1850–1900年的平均值高出1.80 ± 0.12 °C，比2023年10月创下的此前纪录高出约0.12 °C。按异常值计算，这也是自1850年以来名义上最暖的任何月份。 陆地平均气温较1850–1900年平均值高出2.35 ± 0.14 °C（4.24 ± 0.25 °F），名义上成为陆地区域有记录以来第三暖的10月。 海洋温度较1850–1900年平均值高出1.34 ± 0.10 °C（2.42 ± 0.18 °F），这是有记录以来海面温度最高的10月，且优势明显。厄尔尼诺现象在整个10月持续增强，目前已达到有记录以来的最强水平。 当前预测显示，其峰值将出现在2026年12月左右，这将超过现代有记录以来的任何一次厄尔尼诺事件。 地球表面约14.4%的区域经历了有记录以来最热的10月。东南亚大陆地区遭遇了创纪录的10月高温。根据我们的分析，越南的10月气温比该国历史纪录高出0.94 °C，柬埔寨、老挝、缅甸、菲律宾和泰国也均刷新了各自的10月全国纪录。 2026年几乎可以确定（概率约为97%）将成为伯克利地球（Berkeley Earth）有记录以来最暖的一年，这一概率较9月份更新的约96%有所上升。 该年气温较1850–1900年平均值高出1.5 °C（2.7 °F）的可能性几乎已成定局。 全球概况 根据伯克利地球（Berkeley Earth）的高分辨率气温数据集，2026年10月是自1850年有记录以来最暖的10月，全球月平均气温较1850–1900年（工业革命前）平均值高出1.80 ± 0.12 °C (3.25 ± 0.22 °F)，较1850–1900年（工业革命前）平均值高出1.80 ± 0.12 °C。该数值比此前保持纪录的2023年10月高出约0.12 °C，且在考虑不确定性后，其排名毫无疑问。 若以异常值衡量，2026年10月在1850年以来2122个月中，名义上也是所有月份中温度最高的。 自1850年以来各年10月的全球平均气温，相对于1850–1900年的平均值。2026年10月位居榜首
